title: Mopeka Propane Tank Failure Rate
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mopeka:tank
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(tank_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by tank_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Mopeka propane tank records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each tank name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize tank_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per tank name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your Mopeka propane tank data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
